To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
desired-gain indices combined with robust selection is an efficient way to select the key traits and non-key traits simultaneously in radiata pine improvement programmes.

(1) desired-gain index is an efficient tool for incorporating the non-key traits in breeding programme; (2) robust selection concept is a useful way for dealing with the uncertainty of the economic weights of the non-key traits.
desired-gain indices and robust selection can be used to incorporate non-key traits into the breeding programmes of radiata pine.

the development of a desired-gain selection index that can be applied in radiata pine tree improvement programme.
the improvement of the non-key traits in a radiata pine breeding program.
